items.difficulty_reason: Ordinary holomorphic ODE theory cannot directly recover the unbounded skew-adjoint evolution from zero observation. The authors first build a uniform high-frequency observation inverse and propagate regularity with the complete commutator/resolvent argument, then construct the source-specific real and complex nonlinear reconstruction with uniform contraction and holomorphic parameter control. Their full time-translation and reconstruction argument reduces the remaining observed solution to a bounded Banach-space ODE, supplying the new finite-time analyticity obligation after the precise standard ODE and contraction prerequisites.
